clips.title: The story
paras: Kul Tiran marines still hold Tiragarde Keep on Durotar's Scuttle Coast, south of Razor Hill. Built during Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's invasion, the ruined stronghold remains garrisoned under Lieutenant Benedict, a hostile thorn in the Horde's own territory.

Tiragarde Keep gave Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's fleet a beachhead on Durotar's red shores. He built it during his campaign to destroy Thrall's newly founded realm. The Horde eventually broke the siege and killed Proudmoore at Theramore Isle, but the keep was never fully abandoned. Resupply forces under Lieutenant Benedict reclaimed its shattered stone walls. They follow the late Admiral's standing orders to wage unyielding war against the orcs and reject the peace Lady Jaina Proudmoore forged.

White battlements rise above Durotar's crimson cliffs, and Kul Tiran sailors and marines patrol them. The garrison raids supply lines near Razor Hill. For the Horde, the keep remains an ongoing security crisis and a live proving ground: orc and troll commanders send young warriors to assault the fortress and cut down Benedict's soldiers. They seek to contain the garrison before the humans can push farther inland.
